name: METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research)
summary: A nonprofit in Berkeley, led by Beth Barnes, that measures what frontier AI agents can do on their own and whether their developers could lose control of them: it evaluates models before release with AI companies (GPT-4o, o1-preview and Claude 3.5 Sonnet in 2024), builds task suites calibrated on human experts, and analyses companies' frontier safety policies. It began as ARC Evals inside the Alignment Research Center and became a charity of its own in 2024; it takes no money from AI companies.
